rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for extinction or complete destruction when no narrower target is intended.

example.english: This war led to the extinction of an ancient civilization.
example.traditional: 呢場戰爭令一個古老文明滅絕。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 zin3 zang1 ling6 jat1 go3 gu2 lou5 man4 ming4 mit6 zyut6

rows.note: Use this for the extinction of a species, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: If we do not protect them, this species of turtle will soon face extinction.
example.traditional: 如果再唔保護，呢種龜好快就會絕種。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 m4 bou2 wu6 ni1 zung2 gwai1 hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 zyut6 zung2

rows.note: Use this for the extinction or downfall of a kingdom, empire, regime, or civilization rather than a species.

example.english: Tyranny drove this dynasty to extinction.
example.traditional: 暴政令呢個王朝走向滅亡。
example.jyutping: bou6 zing3 ling6 ni1 go3 wong4 ciu4 zau2 hoeng3 mit6 mong4
